7b269b1a9b56.title: Software Engineer Intern
7b269b1a9b56.description_html:
Introduction

We value candidates who have significant experience with managing complexity, working independently, and are motivated by hard problems.

What We Offer

  • The ability to have real impact on mission-critical workflows

  • The chance to use state-of-the-art tech to solve novel problems with mission partners

  • The opportunity to define your role through time as we grow

  • Competitive salary and equity upside with annual merit refreshes based on impact

Position Overview

As a Software Engineer Intern, you’ll work alongside our engineering team to build ConductorAI’s core application: a user-facing web platform for large-scale document search, review, and AI-powered workflows. You’ll contribute to real production systems, including document-processing pipelines, agentic workflow execution, database scaling, and applications that push state-of-the-art LLMs to their limits.

This is a product engineering role as much as a systems role. You’ll help design and build intuitive interfaces for complex, document-centric workflows and see how the software you build is used to solve real problems across defense, government, and regulated commercial environments.

You won’t be confined to low-stakes intern projects. You’ll be trusted with meaningful work on our product’s critical path and given the opportunity to own features from problem definition through implementation. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers who will provide mentorship and technical guidance while giving you the autonomy to experiment, learn quickly, and take on increasingly challenging problems.

We’re looking for interns with strong computer science fundamentals, a generalist mindset, and the curiosity and drive to learn new technologies quickly. You’ll join a small, tight-knit technical team where interns work directly alongside full-time engineers and have meaningful visibility into how an early-stage company builds products, makes technical decisions, and scales.

This internship is intended to be a pathway to future opportunities at ConductorAI. Strong performers may have the opportunity to return for additional internships or co-ops or join the team full-time after graduation.


Location

This internship is open to candidates based in the US, with a strong preference for candidates who can work from our NYC or DC offices for the summer.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and improve search, review, and AI-powered agents for accuracy and consistency

  • Build polished, reliable user-facing features in our Next.js/React application

  • Develop backend APIs, data models, and workflow execution paths that support responsive frontend experiences

  • Write high-quality, maintainable code alongside a small team of experienced engineers

  • Contribute to the design and architecture of production systems

  • Own meaningful features and technical problems from initial idea through implementation

  • Work closely with engineers, product teammates, and users to understand problems and help translate them into product improvements

  • Learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions, and take increasing ownership as you become familiar with our product and codebase

Qualifications

  • US citizenship required; this role supports work subject to US government contract obligations and export control regulations (ITAR/EAR)

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and demonstrated software engineering ability through internships, coursework, research, projects, or other experience

  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, with an ability and willingness to work across our Python and TypeScript/React stack

  • Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to learn unfamiliar technologies quickly

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Product-minded approach with an interest in building software that is intuitive and useful

  • Proactive, high-ownership mindset and willingness to tackle challenging, ambiguous problems

Nice to Haves

  • Previous software engineering internship or meaningful experience building and shipping software

  • Experience with Python, TypeScript, React, or Next.js

  • Experience building with LLMs, AI agents, RAG, or other AI engineering techniques

  • Experience with backend systems, APIs, databases, or distributed systems

  • Familiarity with document processing or search/retrieval systems

  • Experience contributing to open-source software, research, technical clubs, hackathons, or substantial personal projects

  • Experience working in a startup or other fast-paced technical environment

  • Interest in defense, intelligence, national security, or other complex operational domains

  • Active or current security clearance

Responsibilities

  • Develop automation opportunities that improve business efficiency
  • Support application lifecycle management and deployment activities
  • Participate in solution architecture reviews

Technologies Exposure

  • Power Apps
  • Power Automate
  • Power BI
  • Microsoft Dataverse
  • SharePoint Online
  • Microsoft 365

  • Azure Services

What Students Will Learn

  • Enterprise software development
  • Business process automation
  • Data integration
  • API connectivity
  • Solution architecture
  • User experience design
  • Agile development practices

7bcb73b2ed66.title: 2027 BT RISE Internship - Information Security
7bcb73b2ed66.description_html:
Summary:

Under the general supervision of the Department Director and assigned mentor, and according to established Firm policies and procedures, the Intern performs a variety of functional and administrative duties for the Firm. The Intern will work collaboratively with department team members on specific short and long-term projects related to their field of study and firm priorities with a focus on all aspects of Information Security, including Cyber Security. Activities will be assigned by the Department Director based on business needs and learning opportunities for the Intern.

Internship Eligibility:

The BT R.I.S.E. Internship Program is designed to introduce students in specified fields of study to the day-to-day operations of a law firm. Candidate’s skill, knowledge, aptitude, and education will be considered during the selection process.

To be eligible candidates must:

  • Entering their sophomore, junior, or senior year in the Fall of 2027.

  • Be available to participate for 10 consecutive weeks.

  • Enrolled in a 2-4 year undergraduate degree program at time of internship

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support assigned department to deliver meaningful work that advances business initiatives related to the implementation of Information Security initiatives for the firm.

  • Collaborate with work team members on focused projects, data input, data analysis, process documentation, and recordkeeping.

  • Participate in internal and external meetings to develop an aptitude for their field of study and business acumen.

  • Observe confidentiality in all client and Firm matters.

  • Collaborate with other departments and summer interns, where applicable

  • Other duties as assigned.

The intern must be able to perform all essential job duties and responsibilities of this position satisfactorily and as outlined, with or without reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodation requests may be accommodated, absent undue firm hardship.

Qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in an accredited college/university program to receive college course credits.

  • Pursuing a degree in fields of study that aligns with the following departments: Human Resources, Accounting, Marketing, Information Technology, and Legal Operations.

  • Ability to concentrate and pay close attention to detail when performing work functions.

  • Ability to proofread typed material for contextual, grammatical, typographical or spelling errors.

  • Strong interpersonal skills necessary in order to communicate in person, by email, phone, and virtually.

  • Ability to follow instructions effectively from a diverse group of clients, attorneys, and staff.

  • Provide timely and accurate information with ordinary courtesy and tact.

  • Ability to operate standard office equipment, including personal computer,

copiers, phones, and scanning equipment.

  • Ability to work collaboratively and independently.

This job description is intended to describe the general requirements of this position. As such, it is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of job duties or responsibilities required in this job. Subject to firm needs, duties and responsibilities of this position may change at any time, on a temporary or permanent basis, and with or without notice

Working Conditions:

  • Onsite work required.

  • Normal office environment with little exposure to excessive noise, dust, temperature and the like.

  • Specific work hours for this position will be assigned; generally, core business hours. The requirements may vary occasionally, depending on the needs of the firm.

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities or requirements.
